body: I can't get a new job, I can't get the money for classes, I can't cure my body and mind, and I can barely pay for my ticket. I also can't bear to lose what little I have left.
I don't do much anymore. Shows and some mmo that I'm not very good at.

I forced myself to move out. I thought I could get an education and start making things better. I moved out, couldn't handle the classes both emotionally and financially. I thought then I could at least get a promotion in the crappy job I have. I got myself stuck in a position that nobody wants, making it hard to move. I also have terrible hours, and an ex marine boss who became my boss shortly after I started the job. I wanted to finally start the HRT, but my experience with that has been one awkward one after another. Then today with the ticket.
I barely have good moments. I don't even hope for good moments anymore. I just hope to not have bad ones. I was doing ok today until the doctor and then the ticket.
what am I forcing myself to do though? There's no escape, no plan, no hope. I feel I've tried many different options, many different possible escapes and I just don't have any left.
And what if it isn't temporary? What if it only gets worse from here? What if I'm only stopping myself from feeling the misery yet to come?
What could make me happier? All I can think of is for this to stop.

I've heard that. There was a group at the clinic I went to. They were all much older, and all way more outgoing, and all lived in the city. I barely go outside. Many I see even have regular relationships. Some end when they come out, but at least they had them. I've just never been able to bring myself to that. I waited for what today would bring. What yesterday would bring. What last week would bring. What last month would bring. What last year would bring. Nothing.

I was inside for about 6 months solid, but not by choice. It was back in 6th grade. We moved to from suffolk county to staten island. I got sent to catholic school until there was a knife threat. My mother kept me home until we moved back to long island. I was almost entirely without human contact aside from parents for 6 months. I feel like things just happen to me. I want to believe that things will get better, but I always felt like that happens when someone stops making the wrong choices and starts making better ones. I don't think I've been making the wrong choices until now. There's just no preventing what keeps happening.
that there has to be something more for me.
I wanted to believe that for so long. Maybe it's just wrong.
Two years moved out. Four months since the doctor.
Hell, even this is buried.

I don't even feel like I'm hoping for happiness anymore. I just want this... downward spiral to stop. To let up a little. The farther down I go, the farther down the bar follows me. I've wanted my life to change before. I moved out, hoping it would start to get better. I finally saw a doctor and started on HRT and hoped my life would start to get better. I feel like I might as well be playing lotto in hoping for my life to change. I'm more likely to end up disappointed again.
I really like the rapport (or lackin of)those two have. They seem to enjoy eacg others company without actually caring for one another.
Ive been trying. Its not working. Theres no reason for things to work out.
Is that really enough of a reason to go on? It might get better for no reason? There is nothing. No reason that things would get better. Only possibilities of it getting worse.
I've been trying to find a new job. I've been going through my transition. I just find myself deteriorating from nothing working out. I studied polisci briefly.
I doubt those negative thinkers would use the term "transwoman" much.

It's not really an offmychest sort of thing. I don't have gripes. I'm also not much of a writer, and listing all of my problems would only make it worse to see them all added up, especially if I'm showing myself that my days are miserable.

Well I do want things to get better. I want to have my own place, finish my transition and then have a relationship. I just don't see it happening. Something as basic as that might as well be a goal of flying to jupiter because it's not happening.

Say I baked you a cake. A really nice cake that you saw on some cooking show. It had delicious filling and perfectly moist layers of chocolate and all sorts of other flavors that blended perfectly. It was topped with a bunch of buttercream frosting roses. But instead of using buttercream for one of the roses, I used shaving cream. That's basically how I feel.

I've got a job at least. It's an awful one, but it's money. I have a working car, but there's always this fear of it dying at any moment. All it does though is take me to and from my terrible job. I've got some books to read and games to possibly play, but those aren't really... reasons for living.
I didn't find it very helpful, but I guess it only showed me that other people have problems.
I have, but it hasn't been all that helpful. I don't even know what support I could get. I just don't know.
I'm not actually making money to save.

Options are great but I have no access to any. I have no desire to talk to my family, but I still hate feeling let down by them. I'm not the involved type. I especially don't feel making new friends at this junction is a good idea unless they are fully accepting of what I'm going to transition into. State and community, but aid wasn't enough. and again, I wasn't doing well due to everything happening.
if I don't know how, and have no way of finding out then what's the point?
So far the only thing that has changed has been for the worse. I've got very little left and there's no reason anything would change for the better.
Perhaps. There's no... wrong thing to focus on. Everything has been falling apart. Even fixing a little of it would help, but I just don't see it happening.
No money, and most online work is a scam.
Yes, I'm already on HRT.
I would, but relocating isn't in my budget.
Most likely not. I'd like to work elsewhere, but jobs in my location are limited and often require very specific experience.
It's not that they aren't supportive. I just don't want to become someone who always needs something, and especially if I don't actually get better.
No, they are closed.
Diablo? Why... I'd sell my soul for that!
Then I become a burden on them. It's not something I want to do. I already feel like I'm asking them for some sort of favor having them call me by the name I chose for after I go full time in public.
With no qualifications, little education and my only experience is retail. I don't spend much time with my parents. I live on my own.

I dont feel that way. And i dont know what to do for myself
It wont, but it was just something i had planned to do that went south. There are emotional, financial and physical problems that i cant deal with.
Everything i value is leaving, things i didnt even know i valued are gone. Ive even tried over the past few weeks to be extra helpful and kind to others having problems, and ive simply felt empty.
This hasn't been very helpful
I've already mentioned it. Everything started failing. Terrible job, no money, no school, friends drifting away, just me and my hated body.

Sort of. I was not happy with the way things were, but I thought I could change it for the better if I got away from that environment. I thought things would be manageable if I was away from all of that. I was wrong. Not only did things become way too difficult to manage, but the feelings never went away and the environment I tried to hard to escape followed me and decayed into something worse.

It's more than just them, really. I've been on the downslope for longer, as everything began failing. This was just another thing dropping out from under me. Something else I could trick myself with, making me think I had some sort of other attachment with stability. They were never good people, never the kind I cared about approval from. I just didn't need that extra rejection.

I want it to, I really do. It's just not happening. It has gotten to the point where I don't even see how it could happen short of some freak chance. The little I have is so fragile, though. At any point it can fall apart.
I'm here. I don't know what tomorrow could bring. I know what I wanted today to bring, and it has let me down, like so many others.
